shots.name: doer-rule
shots.caption: Whoever submits a List did its procedures: a Booking a colleague does moves to a new List of theirs and its payable follows; a prepaid Booking's payable stays the AA Holding account, the new anaesthetist claims the prepaid amount and nothing is recalculated
